documents.title: Mulching Berry Plants
documents.full_text: A layer of organic mulch can reduce weeds around berry plants. Keep the material away from the crown to limit rot.

documents.title: Bread Fermentation
documents.full_text: Dough fermentation depends on temperature and starter activity. A baker watches volume and texture instead of relying only on elapsed time.

documents.title: Cleaning a Bicycle Chain
documents.full_text: A bicycle chain should be cleaned and dried before lubricant is applied. Excess lubricant attracts road grit.
